notes.title: Birders! We're celebrating Flamecraft's release and Wingspan 6th anniversary with 3 new player portraits, free for everyone!

items.text: Since it's such a big day for our studio, we wanted to prepare something extra special for the occasion. An idea came up, and our extremely talented art team jumped on it right away, creating three original player portraits:
a Bread Dragon in a Onesie
a Gryphon
and a Plant Dragon
They are available right now for free as a permanent addition to your collection. You'll find them in your player profile settings!
Our special Anniversary Background is also coming back, and you can enjoy it until September 24th!
Happy birding, and we invite you to visit Flamecraft's cozy town!

notes.title: A new patch has landed on Steam!

items.text: In this one, we introduce various gameplay and UI improvements, bird power fixes, and a new feature: Card Tray Preview!
You will now find a new button in the game, located under the "Overview" button. This button opens the full card tray, where you can see:
the current bird cards in the tray,
the top card of the bird discard pile,
the top card of the bonus discard pile,
counters indicating how many cards remain in each deck,
counters indicating how many cards are currently in each discard pile.

notes.title: Check the full patch notes below

items.text: Fixed bird cards artwork overlapping when repeating Great Eared Nightjar's power.
Fixed 4-digit numbers misaligning in cached food counters.
Fixed turn order progression not always progressing clockwise for bird powers that allow all players to draw food or cards (e.g., Purple Sunbird, Common Loon).
Fixed Game End food caching powers incorrectly displaying doubled values.
Fixed undoing the upgrade of the Grassland's action with cached seed not returning the seed to the player's supply.
Fixed Rose-Ringed Parakeet incorrectly highlighting as playable in the Wetland when another player has a bird that plays on top of another bird.
Fixed the highlighting of playable cards in hand during card tucking.
Fixed American Oystercatcher not unlocking in the Birds atlas.
Resetting the card tray with a spare Duet token during a bird power's activation is now consistent across all bird powers.
The player order on the end-of-round goal and spent nectar screens now matches the player order for the current round.
Refreshed the overview icon.

Added: Card Tray Preview. Players can now preview the card tray in a separate window using the button below the overview. The preview shows the current bird card tray, the top cards of the bird and bonus card discard piles, and counters showing the number of cards remaining in each deck and discard pile.
Happy birding!

items.text: In this one, we fix several gameplay issues involving bird powers, bonus cards, Automa games, and card interactions, along with some improvements to the Preserve Archive. Also, Western Yellow Wagtail no longer breaks the chain when scoring the Ranger bonus cards!
Check the full patchnotes below!
Fixed spending an egg to upgrade the Wetland's action and leaving to the main menu before confirming, causing the egg to be lost.
Fixed skipping when copying bonus card powers with Marsh Warbler, causing a soft lock.
Fixed caching the 4th round's goal with Daurian Jackdaw, causing a gameplay lock in games against Automa.
Fixed Great Eared Nightjar removing bird cards from the deck after a failed hunt.
Fixed Great Eared Nightjar skipping food caching after drawing the last card left in the deck.
Fixed viewing the opponent's board when choosing the starting hand, clearing the selection of starting bird cards.
Fixed Tundra Swan not activating in games against Automa.
American Oystercatcher now allows drawing cards both from the deck and the tray.
[Only in English] Luzon Bleeding-Heart now counts toward the Photographer bonus card, as Additional Asian Avians add "blood" to the list.
[Only in English] Tufted Titmouse now counts toward the Anatomist bonus card, as Birds of Canada will add "tuft" to the list.
Western Yellow Wagtail no longer breaks the chain for the Ranger bonus cards.
The players' order on the game-end scoring screen now corresponds with the players' order in the 4th round.

Improvements to the Preserve Archive - archived games are now sorted by date, with the most recent on top. Scrolling and deleting archived games is now easier. Added icons for game mode and online games.
Remember to update your game and happy birding!

releases.displayName: Wingspan Online Update Is Now Live!

notes.title: You’ve been sharing your thoughts with us, and we’ve been listening. Thanks to your feedback, the Online mode just got a bunch of quality-of-life upgrades

items.text: 🪶In-game “Your Friends” list - set up games quicker with your favourite Birders!
“Your Friends” option in the Online menu allows you to add other Wingspan players to your list by typing in their in-game nicknames.
The list displays two sections: your platform friends and Wingspan in-game friends.
Check the star for your favourite in-game friends to display them at the top of the “In-game Friends” list.
When setting up a custom online game, use the “Invite a friend” option to easily add your friends to the match - either in bulk or one by one.
Now, whenever a player times out or forfeits in a matchmaking or a custom online game, AI will step in their place!
In the matchmaking games, this means the remaining players can finish the match and gain Karma!
🌺Oceania Expansion in the Duet Matchmaking - enjoy the sweet nectar with both Asia and Oceania Expansions enabled!
🔔Online Notifications - never miss your move again! You’ll now receive in-game alerts when:
it’s your turn in another matchmaking game, and/or
there’s only 1 minute left before your turn times out.
You can tweak these notifications in the game settings anytime.
🐛Bug report visibility is now an option that can be easily changed in Settings.
We hope these updates make your time in Wingspan even smoother, more fun, and more Birder-friendly. Thank you for helping us make the game better!
As always - check out the new features and let us know what you think!
Happy gaming!

items.text: September is extra special to us as the next Wingspan Digital anniversary is heading our way – and we have many surprises prepared for you!
We’re starting with a new patch! It fixes a bunch of bird power issues, improves UI and gameplay flow, and makes some changes to Automa. The patch is now live on all platforms.
We might have slipped in a little surprise – make sure to check out the full patchnotes here:
5th Anniversary player portrait
Automa will now only take the actions allowed for each specific round in Champ of the Birds challenges
Automa will no longer make a double move at the start of rounds 2,3 and 4
Mute Swan will now properly recognize when wetland has no birds played
Fixed an issue where the deck was unclickable when using Indian Peafowl’s power in Overview mode
Emu will no longer allow players to re-roll twice when the bird feeder is empty
Tweaked several bird powers that interacted with bird tray incorrectly after using a reset token in Duet mode.
Fixed an issue with blurred nicknames on the end-of-round goal screen in online mode.
Added reminder text about nectar to the Winter Feeder bonus card. Interaction with birds scoring bonus cards before the game end was fixed.
Tutorial will no longer get stuck after entering pause menu in specific cases
Undoing consecutive “Play another bird” powers will no longer allow placing a bird in the wrong habitat
Infinite card draw exploit of migrating birds has been fixed
\ Stability fixes for rare cases of faulty Game Center connection
Egg-streme Measures ACHIEVEMENT/TROPHY will now unlock properly if egg limit is exceeded
Large Billed Crow will be counted towards “Attempted Murder” Achievement/Trophy

Make sure to try out this week’s Champ of the Birds challenge – it was prepared by one of our most successful and experienced birder, Jolex. Try out your skills and share your scores on our Discord server. May the best birder win!
Have a great week!

For those of you playing with a controller, we’ve made a few improvements:
The "undo" action available when a pop-up to confirm an action was active.
Trying to play a bird without the required food using a GAME END power, displaying a non-interactive pop-up.
Backing out of the Grassland bonus conversion action resulting in the controller losing focus.
We hope this update smooths things out and makes your experience even better. And of course, we hope you’re enjoying the Asia Expansion!
Have a great week,
Monster Couch Team

*If you’ve already signed up for our previous beta tests for Quilts & Cats of Calico, you don’t have to do it again.

P.S. We’re celebrating the Soon™ anniversary so our beachy Oceania background is again available! Play with it until November 29th. We have come a long way since then and Wingspan has undergone many changes and improvements in its backend. Thank you for being with us all this time and supporting us in our work.
